title: Signals beamed into Benowitz's computer from across the street

tellings.quote: Yes, maybe that happened. I mean that's I the person that told me that was was was Bill.

plain: In Albuquerque in the early 1980s, signals are said to have been beamed into the computer of a man named Benowitz from across the street, as part of a deliberate operation aimed at him. Greg Bishop tells the story with some caution ("Yes, maybe that happened") and says the man who told him was Bill Moore. Bishop tells it in an episode about how a man was driven to madness by what he believed were aliens.
